environment.tool: RevitBridge 0.4.0 (local Revit API bridge, MCP) with run_csharp
environment.model: owner R&D model: small accessory dwelling, workshared cloud model

changelog.change: First recorded (IN-0032, owner session; curator is the same occupant as the author, disclosed)

title: Detail annotation at the element: grouped notes, shoulder leaders, no crossings
use_when: annotating a drafting or detail view with text notes and leaders
a reviewer asks for notes at the element instead of a numbered legend
checking a detail for crossing leaders, leaders through dimensions or text, duplicate lines
not_for: tag families driven by parameters (use governed tags)
deciding what a note says: content, product and engineering values stay with their owners

test_runs.model: owner R&D model, 5 detail views (81 leaders)
test_runs.note: after layout; it found 2 leaders without shoulder and 2 dimension-tick duplicates that were then fixed or excluded

model_assumptions: Leaders are straight with one elbow
Dimension witness ticks are thin detail lines referenced by a dimension
not_for: Leaders through dimension lines: see the rule's DA-04 obstacle test
Whether a note names the right component (human review)
